part.text:
Done. The root cause was in `isoptish` (src/main.c:108): it used `isalpha(text[1])` to detect option-like arguments, so `-0` was rejected and treated as the jq program instead of an option, while the long form `--nul-output` worked. The fix adds `isdigit(text[1])`, making `-0` recognized and enabling the existing `RAW_OUTPUT | RAW_NO_LF | RAW_NUL` handling:

- `jq -0 '.[]'` on `["a","b"]` now emits `a\0b\0` (NUL-delimited, no newlines) for `xargs -0`
- Option stacking (`-r0`), non-string output, and `-j` all behave correctly
- Full test suite passes: `make check` — 7/7 jq tests (including the `-0` regression test in tests/shtest), plus all oniguruma tests
